findings.classification: before-execution blocker unless independently enforced by an exact launcher
findings.fact: The wrapper uses assert not sys.flags.optimize to reject optimized execution. Python optimization strips this assert too, together with the other wrapper assertions. An inherited PYTHONOPTIMIZE or -O can therefore remove driver-pin, preservation and union guards.
findings.minimum_resolution: Use an ordinary if sys.flags.optimize: raise ... before relying on assertions; the pinned launcher must compile with optimize=0 and bind actual wrapper bytes. Keep the final independent union validation.
findings.static_counterexample: An old path with a different SHA in full plus one new path still yields new=full\old by path; without the preserved-row assertion the changed old path is omitted from the delta scan while the proof literal still claims old rows preserved. This was reasoned from source, not executed. The separately planned final exact-union checker should reject it if implemented correctly.

findings.classification: narrow outer-envelope hardening; inner manifest types remain strict
findings.fact: Outer JSON uses ordinary json.loads and set equality. Duplicate keys and nonfinite constants are not independently rejected; pin bytes does not have type(value) is int, so a numerically equal float is accepted. Exact supplied SHA and delegated manifest validation still constrain the actual manifest.
findings.minimum_resolution: Reject duplicate and nonfinite outer JSON, require the exact dict/keys, integer nonnegative bytes and canonical SHA/path. Do not weaken the existing manifest validator.

findings.fact: The saved producer is sys.argv[1], not independently shown to be the executed wrapper bytes. The driver is hash-checked before import and later execv reopens its fixed path; keeping that path unchanged through launch is an execution assumption, not an atomic executable-byte guarantee.
findings.minimum_resolution: Use the planned SHA-pinned file launcher; bind __file__ and save the exact verified wrapper bytes. Preserve the scanner pin and actual terminal/producer receipts. No path race was observed in this static task.

The scope directory is ROOT/R1-execution-payload-scope-{phase}-v1 and the scanner results are outside payload under PREPARE_ROOT; the code does not add files to execution-receipts-followup-v1.
Loading the pinned scanner under ModuleType name reviewed_payload_manifest_validation does not run its if __name__ == __main__ block. This conclusion is static only.
The unchanged scanner hashes and scans every declared row, preserves per-file identity, reopens listed paths, rechecks root/manifest, and requires exact count/byte coverage before reporting complete.
